script.speaker: student
script.text: Will the exam have exactly the same format as last year's paper?

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: I wouldn't spend too long on the old paper if I were you.

script.speaker: student
script.text: So the format does change this year?

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: I said what I said. The reading section is worth looking at again.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Understood. Less memorising of old questions, more reading practice.

options.A: The exam will be identical to last year's
options.B: The old paper is not a safe guide, and reading deserves attention
options.C: The reading section has been removed
options.D: Students should memorise the old paper
options.E: There will be no exam this year

question.explain_tr: Öğretmen açıkça söylemiyor ama eski kâğıda güvenmemeyi ima ediyor ve okuma bölümünü işaret ediyor.
question.key_line: I wouldn't spend too long on the old paper if I were you.

script.speaker: student
script.text: When do I get the deposit back after I move out?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Normally within a month, if there is no damage in the room.

script.speaker: student
script.text: The wall was already marked when I arrived.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Did you write that on the form on your first day?

script.speaker: student
script.text: I don't think anyone gave me a form.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Then it will be your word against the report. Take photos today.

question.stem: What is the staff member implying?

options.A: The deposit will certainly be returned
options.B: With no record from the first day, the student may be blamed for the mark
options.C: The student must repaint the wall
options.D: The move-in form does not matter
options.E: Deposits take a year to return

question.explain_tr: Giriş formu yoksa duvardaki iz öğrenciye yazılabilir; bu yüzden bugün fotoğraf çekmesi isteniyor.
question.key_line: Then it will be your word against the report.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I want to take six courses this term instead of five.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: You can. Students who do it usually drop one by November.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I work better under pressure.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Everyone says that in September. Look at your two lab courses first.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Both of them have weekly reports.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Exactly. That is where the time goes.

options.B: The plan usually collapses, especially with two report-heavy labs
options.C: The student should drop a lab course today
options.E: November is the best month to add a course

question.explain_tr: Danışman izin veriyor ama genelde kasımda bırakıldığını, asıl yükün haftalık raporlu iki laboratuvarda olduğunu söylüyor.
question.key_line: Students who do it usually drop one by November.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Can you tell me why my application wasn't accepted?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Your grades were fine. The written part was very short.

script.speaker: student
script.text: There was a five hundred word limit.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: A limit, not a target. Most successful applicants used four hundred and fifty.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Mine was under two hundred.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: That is what the panel noticed first.

options.B: The written part was far shorter than expected
options.C: The student went over the word limit
options.D: The panel never read the application

question.explain_tr: Beş yüz kelime üst sınır; başarılı adaylar dört yüz elli civarı yazmış, öğrenci ise iki yüzün altında kalmış.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Since when can we not book a study room for four hours?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Since students booked rooms and never came.

script.speaker: student
script.text: So the people who used them properly are punished.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: I understand the feeling. But the two hour limit doubled the number of groups that get a room.

script.speaker: student
script.text: That's hard to argue with.

question.stem: What is the staff member's main point?

options.A: The rule exists to punish careless students
options.B: The shorter limit lets far more groups actually get a room
options.D: Four hour bookings are still possible
options.E: The rooms are rarely used at all

question.explain_tr: Görevli şikâyeti anlıyor ama iki saatlik sınırın oda bulabilen grup sayısını ikiye katladığını söylüyor.
question.key_line: But the two hour limit doubled the number of groups that get a room.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Is everything okay? You've been quiet in the meetings.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: It's fine, really. I just do my part and go home.

script.speaker: student
script.text: You used to bring ideas.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: I brought three. All three ended up with someone else's name on the slide.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I didn't know that. I'll change how we credit the work.

question.stem: Why has the friend become quiet?

options.A: She is busy with other courses
options.B: Her ideas were presented under other people's names
options.D: She prefers working on her own
options.E: Nobody ever asked her for ideas

question.explain_tr: Arkadaş 'sorun yok' dese de üç fikrinin başkasının adıyla sunulduğunu söylüyor; sessizliğin gerçek sebebi bu.
question.key_line: All three ended up with someone else's name on the slide.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I have a 3.4 average, so I qualify for the scholarship.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The average is one condition. The other is thirty credits a year.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I took twenty-four last year because of my illness.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Then you can apply with a medical report, but not through the normal form.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Nobody mentioned a second route.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: It's in the same document, further down.

options.A: Her average is too low to apply
options.B: There is a separate route for students with a medical report
options.C: She cannot apply at all this year
options.D: The credit condition does not exist
options.E: The normal form is enough for her case

question.explain_tr: Ortalama yetiyor ama kredi şartı eksik. Rapora dayalı ayrı bir başvuru yolu var, aynı belgenin alt kısmında.
question.key_line: Then you can apply with a medical report, but not through the normal form.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: You cannot come into the laboratory in those open shoes.

script.speaker: student
script.text: It's just one measurement. Two minutes.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The rule doesn't count minutes. It counts what is on the floor.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Nothing has spilled on the floor today.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: That is exactly what we thought last term, before the accident.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Fine. I'll get my other shoes.

question.stem: What is the staff member's argument?

options.A: The measurement will take too long
options.B: The risk does not depend on how long you stay inside

question.explain_tr: Görevli süreyi değil zemindeki riski önemsiyor ve geçen dönemki kazayı hatırlatıyor.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Your argument is clear, but I stopped believing it on page two.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Is the grammar the problem?

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: The grammar is fine. You make a big claim and then give one example from your own life.

script.speaker: student
script.text: So I need sources.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: You need evidence that a reader who disagrees with you would still accept.

question.stem: What does the teacher say the essay needs?

options.B: Evidence that would satisfy a reader who disagrees
options.D: More stories from the student's own life

question.explain_tr: Sorun dil bilgisi değil. Büyük iddia tek kişisel örnekle destekleniyor; karşı görüştekini de ikna edecek kanıt isteniyor.
question.key_line: You need evidence that a reader who disagrees with you would still accept.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Can we move Thursday's meeting to Friday afternoon again?

script.speaker: friend
script.text: That is the third change this month, and it is only the fifteenth.

script.speaker: student
script.text: My shift changed again.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Then tell me which days never change and we will build the meeting around them.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Monday and Wednesday evenings never change.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Good. Wednesday from now on.

question.stem: What does the friend actually want?

options.B: A fixed day that will stop changing
options.C: To meet on Friday instead of Thursday
options.D: The student to change her shift

question.explain_tr: Arkadaş cumaya itiraz etmiyor; sürekli değişikliği bitirecek sabit bir gün istiyor.
question.key_line: Then tell me which days never change and we will build the meeting around them.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I trained all summer, but I'm not in the first team.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Your fitness is the best in the group.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Then why am I on the bench?

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: In the last three matches you passed twice and shot eleven times.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I was trying to help us score.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: The team scores more when the ball moves. That's the whole reason.

question.stem: Why is the student not in the first team?

options.A: His fitness is not good enough
options.B: He shoots instead of passing to the team
options.D: The coach does not like him
options.E: The team never scores any goals

question.explain_tr: Kondisyonu gruptaki en iyisi; sorun topu paylaşmaması. Antrenör pas ve şut sayısını örnek veriyor.
question.key_line: In the last three matches you passed twice and shot eleven times.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I am number forty on the housing waiting list. Is there any hope?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Last year we got to number thirty-five by October.

script.speaker: student
script.text: So probably not.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Unless you accept a shared room. That list moves much faster.

script.speaker: student
script.text: How much faster?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Almost everyone who ticked that box last year got a place.

question.stem: What is the staff member suggesting?

options.A: The student will certainly get a single room
options.B: Accepting a shared room makes a place very likely
options.C: The waiting list never moves at all
options.D: The student should apply again next year
options.E: Thirty-five is the limit for shared rooms

question.explain_tr: Tek kişilik odada sıra kırka ulaşmıyor; paylaşımlı odayı işaretleyenlerin neredeyse tamamı yer almış.
question.key_line: Almost everyone who ticked that box last year got a place.

script.speaker: student
script.text: The program says my licence is already in use.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: It works on two devices. Did you install it on a third?

script.speaker: student
script.text: My laptop, the lab computer, and my old tablet.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The tablet is still counted, even though you never open it.

script.speaker: student
script.text: So I remove it from there first.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes, from your account page, not from the tablet.

options.B: Remove the old device through the account page
options.C: Uninstall the program from the laptop
options.D: Use only the lab computer from now on
options.E: Open the program on the tablet once

question.explain_tr: Kullanılmasa bile tablet bir hakkı işgal ediyor; kaldırma işlemi tabletten değil hesap sayfasından yapılıyor.
question.key_line: Yes, from your account page, not from the tablet.

script.speaker: student
script.text: The menu went up thirty percent and the portions got smaller.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The portions are the same. We changed the plates.

script.speaker: student
script.text: That's worse, isn't it?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: It looks worse. The weight is printed on the board now, if you want to check.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I'll check tomorrow. If it's the same, I'll say so in the group.

question.stem: What does the staff member claim?

options.A: The portions were reduced with the price rise
options.B: Only the plates changed, and the weights are now displayed
options.C: The prices did not change at all
options.D: The board shows the wrong weights
options.E: Students should complain as a group

question.explain_tr: Görevli porsiyonun aynı kaldığını, sadece tabakların değiştiğini söylüyor ve gramajın panoda yazdığını ekliyor.
question.key_line: The portions are the same. We changed the plates.

script.speaker: student
script.text: The internship says thirty hours a week, but I stayed until nine twice.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Were those hours in the agreement?

script.speaker: student
script.text: No, but everyone stays.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Everyone staying doesn't change what you signed. Write the extra hours down.

script.speaker: student
script.text: They won't like that.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Perhaps. But a record protects you if the report is questioned later.

question.stem: What does the staff member advise?

options.B: Keeping a written record of the extra hours

question.explain_tr: Herkesin kalması sözleşmeyi değiştirmiyor. Görevli fazladan saatleri yazılı tutmayı, ileride belge olsun diye öneriyor.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Three of you spoke for eleven minutes and one for forty seconds.

script.speaker: student
script.text: She was very nervous, so the rest of us covered her part.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Covering someone is kind, but the mark is individual.

script.speaker: student
script.text: We didn't know that.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: It's in the brief. Next time give her the easiest section, not none of it.

options.B: Helping a nervous member should not mean leaving her no part
options.C: The mark is given to the whole group together
options.D: The student should have spoken less
options.E: Nervous students should not present at all

question.explain_tr: Not bireysel veriliyor. Arkadaşını korumak iyi niyetli ama ona hiç bölüm bırakmamak notuna zarar veriyor.
question.key_line: Next time give her the easiest section, not none of it.

script.speaker: student
script.text: The system says my book is nine days late, but I returned it on the fourth.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The date on the record is the fourteenth.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I put it in the outside box on a Saturday.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: That box is emptied on Mondays. If it was a long weekend, that explains it.

script.speaker: student
script.text: It was. Can the fine be removed?

question.stem: What probably caused the late record?

options.A: The student really did return the book late
options.B: The outside box was not emptied until after the long weekend
options.C: The system deleted the return record
options.D: The student kept the book for nine extra days
options.E: The staff member typed the date wrongly

question.explain_tr: Kitap cumartesi dış kutuya bırakılmış. Kutu pazartesileri boşaltıldığı ve uzun tatil olduğu için kayıt geç düşmüş.
question.key_line: That box is emptied on Mondays.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I got one email saying I'm registered and another saying payment failed.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The first is automatic. It goes out before the payment is checked.

script.speaker: student
script.text: So I'm not registered.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Not yet. Your place is held until Friday, then it goes to the waiting list.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I'll pay today. I'm not risking a place for a bank delay.

question.stem: What does the staff member explain about the first email?

options.A: It was sent to the student by mistake
options.B: It is automatic and does not confirm that payment succeeded
options.D: It came from the waiting list system

question.explain_tr: İlk e-posta otomatik ve ödeme kontrol edilmeden gönderiliyor; yer yalnızca cumaya kadar tutuluyor.
question.key_line: The first is automatic. It goes out before the payment is checked.
